name: LVLab AI Search Optimizer
author: lvlabnet

sections.description:
LVLab AI Search Optimizer helps WordPress websites prepare content structure, entity signals, schema output, internal discovery, and crawler guidance for AI search systems.

The plugin focuses on practical Generative Engine Optimization signals that can be managed directly inside WordPress. It does not send site content to external AI services.

Features

  • AI Readiness Dashboard with a Welcome Wizard and setup progress.
  • Site Entity Profile for brand name, entity type, description, logo, topics, sameAs profiles, service area, and language.
  • AI Bot Manager for robots.txt rules for AI crawlers and search bots.
  • LLMs.txt Generator with a public /llms.txt endpoint.
  • Auto-generated LLMs.txt URLs from published posts and pages.
  • URL inclusion controls to untick posts or pages that should not appear in LLMs.txt.
  • LLMs.txt guidance fields for main topics, important URLs, content usage policy, and crawl guidance.
  • AI Sitemap Generator with a dedicated /ai-sitemap.xml endpoint.
  • Important Pages manager for AI Sitemap and LLMs.txt.
  • Schema Core for JSON-LD output.
  • Schema conflict controls for popular SEO plugins.
  • Schema preview and basic validator in the admin dashboard.
  • FAQ block for Gutenberg.
  • FAQ Schema support for FAQPage JSON-LD.
  • Classic Editor FAQ fallback metabox.
  • Internal Link Suggestions in the editor.
  • Rule-Based Content Analyzer for structure, entities, answers, links, FAQ, and schema readiness.
  • Entity Graph preview for the site entity profile.

Privacy

LVLab AI Search Optimizer version 1.2.0 does not connect to external services and does not send site content, post data, user data, analytics, or settings to third-party servers.

All plugin settings are stored locally in the WordPress database. Public endpoints generated by the plugin, such as /llms.txt and /ai-sitemap.xml, are available to visitors and crawlers when enabled.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the lvlab-ai-search-optimizer folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin ZIP from the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the LVLab AI Search Optimizer menu in WordPress admin.
  4. Follow the Welcome Wizard to configure Site Entity, AI Bots, Schema, LLMs.txt, AI Sitemap, and content tools.
sections.faq:
Does LVLab AI Search Optimizer send content to an external API?

No. Version 1.2.0 does not send content, post data, settings, or user data to an external API.

Does LVLab AI Search Optimizer replace my SEO plugin?

No. LVLab AI Search Optimizer is designed to work alongside SEO plugins. Its schema conflict controls help reduce duplicate JSON-LD output when popular SEO plugins are active.

Where is the AI Sitemap?

The AI Sitemap is available at /ai-sitemap.xml.

Where is LLMs.txt?

LLMs.txt is available at /llms.txt when enabled in the plugin settings.

Does the plugin modify my main sitemap index?

No. LVLab AI Search Optimizer keeps its AI Sitemap separate to avoid conflicts with WordPress core sitemaps and SEO plugins.

How do I add FAQPage schema?

Add the LVLab AI Search Optimizer FAQ block in the block editor and enable schema for the block. Classic Editor users can use the LVLab AI Search Optimizer FAQPage Schema metabox.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Improved URL list sanitization for LLMs.txt important URLs.
  • Improved SameAs URL list sanitization for Site Entity settings.

1.1.0

  • Improved LLMs.txt with main topics, policy templates, crawl guidance, and clearer setup tips.
  • Added automatic LLMs.txt URL generation from published posts and pages.
  • Added controls to exclude selected auto-generated URLs from LLMs.txt.
  • Reorganized Site Entity settings into simpler guided sections.
  • Updated the AI Sitemap endpoint to /ai-sitemap.xml.

1.0.0

  • Initial production release.
  • Added AI Readiness Dashboard and Welcome Wizard.
  • Added Site Entity Profile and Entity Graph preview.
  • Added AI Bot Manager for robots.txt rules.
  • Added LLMs.txt Generator.
  • Added AI Sitemap Generator.
  • Added Important Pages manager.
  • Added Schema Core with conflict controls, preview, and validator.
  • Added FAQ block and FAQPage schema support.
  • Added Classic Editor FAQ fallback.
  • Added Internal Link Suggestions.
  • Added Rule-Based Content Analyzer.
  • Added LV LAB branding and WordPress.org-ready metadata.
  • Updated production naming and metadata for WordPress.org review.
  • Added a non-intrusive, per-user review request notice.
